displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E3.4
causes: 2nd stage pressure switch did not close
diySteps: The 2nd stage sequence says if pressure switch 2 does not close within 45 seconds, the furnace declares a PS2 open error and keeps running in 1st stage
If PS2 fails on the third attempt in the same heating call, the guide says 2nd stage locks out until the heat call is removed or power is cycled
Technician: check the 2nd stage pressure switch, tubing and inducer. Tubing must rise so condensate does not enter the switch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the furnace will heat on low stage but never steps up, and E3.4 is stored.
